site.name: aeroiq
site.summary: AeroIQ Fictional API monitoring and observability SaaS (Datadog / Vercel Observability-style). Pages - `index.html` — Overview dashboard. Left rail nav; top bar with org switcher, environment tabs (Production / Staging / Dev), time range (5m / 1h / 24h / 7d), search (⌘K), theme toggle, alert bell; four top KPIs (total requests / error rate / p95 / availability) with sparklines and period-over-period deltas; 24-card endpoint health grid (red cards first), each card with HTTP method + path + health dot + RPS / p95 / error rate; right alerts side panel with 8 active alerts and per-row assign / silence actions; bottom global p50 / p95 / p99 trend line chart. - `endpoint-detail.html` — Endpoint detail. Top: method + path + health badge + linked services + owner avatars; 6 KPIs (RPS / error rate / p50 / p95 / p99 / SLO status); three large trend charts (request volume, latency p50/p95/p99 three lines, error rate); error-grouping panel with status-code / client-version / region tabs; recent error sample table (5 rows including 502 Bad Gateway, 500, 429, 503); related traces list. - `alerts.html` — Alerts center. 4 KPIs (active / new today / mean response / MTTR); filter bar; 12-row alert

run_plan.goal: Explore and critique the UX of the AeroIQ system, focusing on the primary dashboard flow, adjacent pages (alerts, endpoints, endpoint detail, service map), and validating key interactions and states across desktop and mobile viewports.
run_plan.summary: The exploration will proceed in phases: first, validate the dashboard (index.html) interactions (time range, environment, org switches, alerts panel). Then, explore endpoints.html (filtering, sorting), alerts.html (alert actions, filters), endpoint-detail.html (KPI trends, error breakdown), and services.html (dependency map). Each phase includes specific checks and mobile validation.
assumptions: All pages load without errors (prescan shows no load errors)
Interactables (buttons, links, inputs) are functional and follow expected behavior
Mobile viewport has responsive layout matching desktop content structure
risk_hotspots: Small tap targets (e.g., environment tabs, time range buttons) may cause usability issues on mobile
Missing input labels (select elements) could reduce accessibility
Complex KPI trend charts (e.g., latency, error rate) may have unclear interaction patterns

phases.title: Dashboard (index.html) Validation
phases.objective: Validate core dashboard interactions, KPI trends, and alerts panel functionality.
key_checks: Click environment tabs (Production → Staging → Dev) and verify KPI updates
Click time range buttons (5m → 1h → 24h → 7d) and check KPI trend changes
Interact with 3-4 endpoint health cards (e.g., POST /v1/payments, GET /v1/users/:id) to ensure hover/click states work
Open/close the active alerts panel (via 'view all' and back) and verify alert actions (Assign, Silence) are clickable
exit_criteria: Endpoint cards and alerts panel are interactive
Mobile viewport: repeat 2 key checks (e.g., environment tab, time range) to validate responsiveness

phases.title: Endpoints (endpoints.html) Exploration
phases.objective: Validate endpoint list filtering, sorting, and detail navigation.
key_checks: Use service filter (e.g., checkout-api, users-svc) and verify endpoint list updates
Use health filter (Healthy → Degraded → Unhealthy) and check endpoint sorting
Search via input (⌘K) for a path (e.g., /v1/payments, /v1/users) and verify results
Click 2-3 endpoint links (e.g., POST /v1/payments, GET /v1/invoices) to navigate to endpoint-detail.html
Sort endpoints by RPS / Error % and verify list order changes
exit_criteria: Endpoint links navigate to detail page (endpoint-detail.html)
Mobile viewport: repeat 2 filter checks (e.g., service filter, search) to validate mobile filtering

phases.title: Endpoint Detail (endpoint-detail.html) Deep Dive
phases.objective: Validate endpoint detail page KPI trends, error breakdown, and related traces.
key_checks: From endpoints.html, click an endpoint (e.g., POST /v1/payments) to open endpoint-detail.html
Verify KPI trends (request volume, latency, error rate) update on hover/click (if interactive)
Check error breakdown tabs (status-code, client-version, region) and verify content switching
Return to endpoints.html and use search (⌘K) for a path (e.g., /v1/invoices) and verify result
exit_criteria: Detail page KPI trends and error breakdown are interactive
Mobile viewport: check 1 KPI trend (e.g., latency) and 1 error breakdown tab

phases.title: Alerts (alerts.html) Validation
phases.objective: Validate alert filtering, sorting, and action workflows.
key_checks: Use severity filter (Critical → Warning) and verify alert list updates
Use status filter (Open → Assigned → Resolved) and check alert list changes
Interact with 3-4 alert rows (e.g., Error rate > 5%, p95 latency > 1000ms) to verify hover/click states
Attempt to assign/silence an alert (e.g., WARNING: Error rate > 3%) and check for confirmation states (if any)
exit_criteria: Mobile viewport: repeat 2 filter checks (e.g., severity, status)

phases.title: Service Map (services.html) and Logs/Integrations (Smoke Test)
phases.objective: Validate service map interactions and smoke test remaining pages (logs, integrations).
key_checks: Click service nodes (e.g., edge-gateway, users-svc) and verify node highlighting/info panels (if any)
Switch environment (Production → Staging) on services.html and check dependency map updates
Navigate to Logs and Integrations pages, verify basic layout (headings, interactables) load
Mobile viewport: check service map node interaction and environment switch
exit_criteria: Logs/Integrations pages load with basic interactables
Mobile responsiveness verified for service map

coverage_targets.pages: Visit all 5 target pages (index, alerts, endpoint-detail, endpoints, services) with at least 2 key checks each
coverage_targets.features: Exercise 80% of visible controls (filters, tabs, buttons, cards) across pages, prioritizing core workflows (KPI trends, alert management, endpoint navigation)
coverage_targets.mobile: Repeat 1-2 critical checks per phase (e.g., environment tab, time range, filter) to validate responsive layout and interactability

notes: Focus on core observability workflows (KPI monitoring, alert triage, endpoint debugging) to align with the product’s purpose
Document any discrepancies in interactable behavior (e.g., unresponsive buttons, broken filters) for critique
